clusters.title: Epistemic/aleatoric belief split: evidential posteriors with explicit precision
clusters.summary: Replace the single scalar variance with a two-channel belief â€” aleatoric outcome sharpness vs epistemic estimate error â€” ideally as a Dirichlet posterior over (W,D,L) whose concentration is earned evidence: an oracle eval contributes fixed pseudo-counts, backups carry the supporting child's concentration, proofs are infinite concentration (variance-zero as a limit, not a special case). Only epistemic uncertainty feeds the broker and court; aleatoric sharpness is never again exploration fuel. The epistemic channel additionally absorbs palimpsest-correction posterior variance, raw-vs-settled subtree disagreement, and domain-mismatch penalties, and deletes the scattered ad hoc /(1+n) shrinkages in court.p_best and the broker's C_VAR term.
clusters.rationale: The founding slogan â€” a guess, a lesson, and a proof are the same object at three precisions â€” is currently a metaphor because precision is not represented anywhere. Today's variance conflates 'genuinely drawish/sharp' with 'the oracle might be wrong': a dead-drawn endgame screams maximum uncertainty forever while a fortress the net confidently misvalues at Wâ‰ˆ0.9 whispers, so the court stops fast on losing moves after minimal work and stays torn on settled draws. Both proposers independently identified this as the substrate everything else stands on: a lattice that cannot say how much it believes itself cannot price information, and pricing information is the broker's and court's entire job. Every downstream consumer â€” broker pricing, court stopping, oracle-fusion weights, distillation loss weights, reheated persistence priors â€” needs this one coherent precision currency.

clusters.title: Honest max: bias-aware distributional backup that fixes the winner's curse
clusters.summary: Replace SettlingEngine.backup's plug-in argmax â€” the parent inherits the single best child's value, variance, and WDL verbatim â€” with a posterior over the max of the children's posteriors (moment-matched Clark pairwise approximation or soft-Bayes-max with variance-tied temperature, still a contraction under gamma, computed in WDL space): the parent mean receives the selection-bias correction, parent variance inflates with top-2 argmax ambiguity, and parent WDL/mlh become the P(child i is best)-weighted mixture of flipped child beliefs.
clusters.rationale: The hard max over uncertain beliefs is the single largest dishonesty in a system whose claim is that stored beliefs stay honest â€” it is the alpha-beta reflex smuggled into a Bayesian object, and the winner's-curse bias compounds rootward through hundreds of plies, so the court makes clock decisions on systematically over-optimistic, over-confident posteriors (directly implicated in the measured draw-heavy optimism vs UCI_Elo 3190). Three consumers are silently poisoned: the broker's exploration bonus targets miscalibrated uncertainty; the court treats biased interior values as Gaussian means; and worst, the Palimpsest learns from settled-minus-raw residuals, so max-bias at high-branching nodes is ingested as oracle pessimism â€” the learner learns the search's optimism. Foundational plumbing for every proposal that consumes variances. It is one changed mathematical operator, no new components.

clusters.title: Posterior-sampling broker: Thompson descent retires PUCT, FPU, and virtual loss
clusters.summary: Replace Broker._score_moves entirely: at each node sample every move's value â€” expanded children from their posteriors, unexpanded moves from a prior-predictive Normal(parent.raw_value + delta(policy prior), sigma0) where delta is an online-learned regression replacing the FPU_PENALTY constant â€” and descend the argmax of the samples. Proven children participate at their exact value so siblings are bought only when a sample beats the guaranteed floor; batches diversify through sampling randomness so VLOSS disappears; at the root, use top-two Thompson sampling, a near-optimal best-arm-identification rule for exactly the question the court is asking.
clusters.rationale: PUCT optimizes a cumulative-regret bandit objective that does not exist here: no payoff accrues during search; the only payoff is whether the move the court will pick changes. Thompson descent spends evals in proportion to the posterior probability that a line is decision-relevant, collapses four hand-set constants (C_PUCT, C_VAR, FPU_PENALTY, VLOSS) into one mechanism with zero tunables, and fixes a concrete betrayal: today a proven-draw child is skipped in scoring, so the broker buys evals on siblings whose entire posterior lies below the guaranteed draw â€” pure waste exactly where lost positions need a save. At 450 evals/s, eval allocation IS the engine; this also defines precisely what the deferred trajectory head should predict (expected sample-flip probability per descent).

clusters.title: Regret-denominated stopping: the court minimizes expected game-point loss, not P(argmax)
clusters.summary: Replace the EARLY_STOP_P/LATE_STOP_P/EXTEND_FACTOR thresholds with expected-regret stopping: from the joint samples the court already draws, compute R = E[max_i q_i âˆ’ q_argmax] in game-point (WDL-utility) units, and stop when R falls below the marginal game-point value of a second of banked clock â€” a strength-vs-time curve estimated online, making bank protection a property of the curve rather than a hand-set extension factor.
clusters.rationale: P(argmax is best) is the wrong loss for a court that calls itself decision-theoretic: it cannot distinguish 'torn between two near-identical moves' (regret ~0, should snap instantly) from 'torn between a win and a blunder' (same P, enormous regret) â€” and court.py's own comments record exactly this failure draining the clock in flat middlegames vs SF-3000. 'Stopping as inference' about the wrong quantity is still a heuristic. The utility vector used to score WDL is also the natural home for opponent-aware draw values, and the honest denomination of the deferred eval-budget item is expected game points per second.

clusters.title: Correlated root posterior with prior-predictive arms for unexpanded root moves
clusters.summary: The court samples root children as independent Gaussians and silently omits every unexpanded root move. Fix one: estimate root-child covariance from the lattice's own structure â€” shared-evidence mass between root-child subtrees (countable during _integrate's existing path-increment pass) and/or an exponentially weighted covariance over per-settle-epoch root q-vector deltas â€” and sample jointly, since the decision-relevant quantities are differences in which common bias cancels. Fix two: enter unexpanded root moves as prior-predictive arms using the learned policy-prior-to-value curve, so confidence is structurally impossible while a plausible move remains unbought.
clusters.rationale: Transposition merging is the whole point of the lattice, so root subtrees physically share nodes â€” the independence assumption overstates confidence exactly when the lattice is doing its job best, and the court stays 'torn' between identical-by-construction values, burning banked clock (the observed flat-eval clock drain). The graph that invalidates independence is the same graph that hands the court the covariance for free; a tree engine could not compute this. Omitting unexpanded moves contradicts the broker's own stated principle ('the frontier never collapses onto a poor explored subset') at the one node where collapse decides the game.

clusters.title: Hierarchical palimpsest with retroactive re-pricing through the dirty queue
clusters.summary: Replace the single exact context key (full pawn masks x material x stm) with a coarse-to-fine hierarchy (material/imbalance class -> pawn-structure family -> exact key) under Bayesian shrinkage, so fresh contexts inherit their parent's posterior instead of staying mute below MIN_EVIDENCE. Make lessons repeated residual observations (settled minus corrected-raw, observation noise shrinking with subtree evidence) instead of one snapshot at evals==32, removing the correction-echo. Store the uncorrected oracle value on the node, give contexts back-pointers to member nodes, and make context-posterior movement a first-class dirty-queue event so a moved lesson re-prices raw_value on nodes already resident and the settler propagates the consequences.
clusters.rationale: palimpsest.py's docstring claims corrections 're-price positions the search has never visited,' but the implementation only prices future node births â€” stale beliefs keep their stale raw_value forever, leaving the architecture's signature capability (mid-game self-revision) half-connected, even though the back-pointered lattice plus prioritized dirty queue make retroactive re-pricing nearly free and no tree engine could express this information flow. And the current contexts are so fine that most never reach MIN_EVIDENCE=3 within one game â€” the in-game-learning claim is mostly silent in practice. Partial pooling is the statistically correct fix because lessons measure the frozen oracle's systematic structural biases, which generalize across exact pawn masks; repricing raw_value through the dirty queue changes settled values across the lattice with zero additional GPU work.

clusters.title: Syzygy as a proof-oracle tier: tablebase hits as variance-zero pinned beliefs
clusters.summary: Add a second oracle beside the neural one: when a broker descent reaches a <=6-man position, probe Syzygy WDL instead of spending a GPU slot, and admit the result through the existing terminal-admission seam as a variance-zero pinned belief; DTZ probes near the root pin mlh so the conversion urge becomes exact rather than a neural guess. Probing is rule50-bucket-aware (cursed wins / blessed losses resolve per halfmove-clock bucket), which the existing R50-salted keys are already shaped for.
clusters.rationale: In alpha-beta a TB hit is a score needing careful interaction with bounds; here a tablebase IS the native object â€” a proof oracle emitting the third precision of the design's own guess/lesson/proof creed, with zero impedance mismatch (Node.make_terminal, proof propagation, and the court's theorem-ends-deliberation rule all already exist). It targets the two biggest measured weaknesses at once â€” endgame conversion and draw-heaviness vs equals: at 450 evals/s STILLWATER will never out-grind Stockfish endings by evaluation, but it does not have to if it can touch bedrock. One deep TB hit proof-propagates rootward, the broker prices the proven subtree at zero and reallocates the whole GPU budget to the unproven boundary, and the court snap-moves.

clusters.title: Saturation-triggered PNS proof bursts: the missing belief-to-proof promotion operator
clusters.summary: A bounded CPU proof-number-search module that fires when a belief saturates (|value| > ~0.9 with forcing moves present) or when the court is torn between near-certain candidates, and tries to promote near-certainty into an exact mate/draw proof within a small node budget. PNS is DAG-native â€” it runs ON the lattice sharing the same nodes (proof/disproof numbers as one more annotation slot) â€” and successes enter as variance-zero pins through existing proof propagation, consuming CPU cycles idle while the GPU evaluates batches.
clusters.rationale: The slogan says a guess and a proof are the same object at different precisions, but today no operator PROMOTES a belief from second to third precision except accidental exhaustive enumeration of terminal children â€” PNS is exactly that missing operator. It is the lattice-native answer to the one battle-proven failure class of PUCT+NN at low evals/s: policy-blind shallow tactics (the engine's own WAC.001 Qg6 miss at 8 seconds) and slow conversion of clearly won positions; check extensions and mate-distance pruning do not transfer as mechanisms, but their essence â€” exhaustive treatment of forcing lines â€” is PNS's home turf. A proof instantly ends court deliberation, converting tactical sharpness into banked clock.

clusters.title: Perpetual settling: a continuous search service with pondering as a non-event
clusters.summary: Invert control: the eval pump (broker -> GPU -> integrate -> settle) becomes a persistent service, and 'think' becomes the Root Court attaching a stopping problem to the current root. On opponent time the broker simply descends from the opponent-to-move position â€” or a policy-weighted distribution over likely replies â€” spreading effort across plausible replies in proportion to priors and values, with no ponder-move guess and no ponderhit/miss machinery because the lattice never re-roots. Court evidence gating must be re-denominated from session counters (evals_this_move >= max(256, 2*batch), 'never move on zero fresh evidence') to lattice-resident evidence (root-cone eval mass and posterior movement) so a root pre-settled on opponent time snap-moves in milliseconds and banks clock.
clusters.rationale: Tree engines pay for pondering with re-rooting, tree-reuse bookkeeping, and a ~50% ponder-miss tax; STILLWATER's founding premises â€” position-keyed beliefs, free transpositions, re-rooting is a no-op â€” make opponent-time deliberation literally free, and refusing it wastes roughly half of wall-clock for an engine whose binding constraint is 450 evals/s. Opponent time is a ~2x evidence multiplier concentrated exactly in the draw-heavy equal middlegames where p_best stays torn and the court currently runs out of clock; combined with snap-moves on pre-settled roots it is a clock-banking machine that compounds the engine's hardest-learned lesson (horizon-aware budgets after endgame clock starvation). Retrofit is expensive: think() owning the while-loop, reset_flight() per move, and elapsed-from-t0 accounting all assume search exists only inside the engine's own clock.

clusters.title: The Lens: one WDL-utility object at all comparison sites (native contempt, draw handling, objective switching)
clusters.summary: Replace the scalar eff_value(v, mlh) with a single explicit utility functional u(W, D, L, mlh; ctx) consulted at exactly the existing comparison sites (backup argmax, broker scoring, _best_move, court root_stats), where ctx carries opponent model, match state (must-win/draw-suffices), and side. Core form u = u_W*W + u_D*D + u_L*L plus a drift-horizon term generalizing the mlh urge into an error-exposure horizon. Supports objective switching â€” E[value] normally, P(win) in must-win contexts, P(not-loss) when defending â€” impossible with a collapsed scalar, trivial with the triple. The court samples in utility space; stored beliefs remain untouched and honest.
clusters.rationale: STILLWATER already stores and propagates full WDL distributions at every node, then throws the draw mass away by collapsing to Wâˆ’L before every comparison: a node with (0.30, 0.55, 0.15) and one with (0.15, 0.85, 0.00) both score 0.15 today, so vs SF-3190 the engine has no way to prefer the live position â€” and the draw mass is exactly where the measured flat-eval draw problem lives. This is the one architecture where contempt is a one-line change of comparison operator rather than Stockfish's eval-offset hack or Lc0's retrofit, because beliefs are persistent shared objects and decisions are ephemeral â€” utility changes which child wins the argmax without poisoning the settling operator's honest fixed point. The codebase already learned that comparison operators must agree at all sites or backup argmax and court argmax diverge; this is also the concrete mechanism behind the deferred 'opponent-aware draw-utility', honoring the no-static-contempt decision (u_D defaults to 0, driven by opponent context).

clusters.title: Decision-relevance steering: a propagated influence field plus the missing court-to-broker feedback channel
clusters.summary: Add a second quantity flowing opposite to value backups: each node carries an influence weight approximating P(a shift in this node's belief changes the root decision), computed by chaining softmax-of-children responsibilities down from the root and refreshed lazily along descents and after settling waves; the broker's leaf price becomes influence x expected belief revision instead of purely local Q+U terms. Close the loop the other way too: the court's joint posterior identifies the contested root set (the 2-3 candidates that trade argmax wins in joint samples) and hands the broker a root-level sampling bias so descents concentrate on resolving that specific comparison â€” the native form of singular extensions, denominated in expected movement of the decision posterior per eval.
clusters.rationale: Alpha-beta's efficiency miracle is not depth, it is decision-relevance pruning â€” windows are proofs a subtree cannot affect the root choice; LMR, null-move, and aspiration windows are tree-shaped carriers of that idea and do not transfer as mechanisms. STILLWATER currently has no carrier for the essence: C_VAR is local, and the Court computes the exact decision posterior but uses it only to STOP, never to STEER â€” a court-to-broker information flow that simply does not exist today even though the expensive part (the joint posterior) is already paid for and recomputed continuously. Once utility is asymmetric this channel becomes load-bearing: the contested root pair is characteristically (safe drawish move) vs (tense regret-seeking move), settled only by deep targeted evidence â€” generic variance-chasing spreads budget across all flat siblings and the engine times out still torn, the measured 'torn is the common case at 350 evals/s' lesson. This is also the honest v1 of the docstring's trajectory-head promise: reach IS the influence field, computable from the lattice now and trainable later.

clusters.title: Sediment layer: opening preparation as read-only imported prior beliefs
clusters.summary: A read-only, disk-resident shard of pre-settled beliefs (position key -> WDL, variance, evidence mass, priors) consulted at node birth through the same seam as the palimpsest correction. Book construction is running the engine's own settling offline (or distilling Lc0/SF prep) and serializing the opening cone; at the board, a well-evidenced import makes the court clear its bar instantly and snap-move, while a refuted line is self-correcting because imports carry nonzero variance and finite evidence that live settling can outvote.
clusters.rationale: Every top engine ships opening preparation; STILLWATER re-derives move-5 theory at 450 evals/s on the clock, squandering its hard-won banked-time discipline in the one phase where answers are precomputable. The lattice-native translation is uniquely clean: a book is not a move list with a separate arbiter and an out-of-book cliff â€” it is just MORE LATTICE, pre-settled, entering through the existing belief algebra, indistinguishable in datatype from live search. The 'no persistence across games' principle is sharpened rather than dropped: no learned persistence (the palimpsest still dies with the game), but read-only prep import is a different epistemic category â€” priors, not lessons.

clusters.title: Graded eviction replaces clear-on-full: retention scoring, proof ledger, palimpsest compression, link integrity
clusters.summary: Replace the over-capacity lattice.clear() with incremental, concurrent eviction ranked by retention value (root-reachability coloring recolored as the root advances x evidence mass x variance x staleness, x influence when the decision-relevance field exists â€” never raw age). Never evict proofs or the root cone: proofs persist in a compact eviction-exempt ledger (key -> certificate + certifying move, consulted like a private tablebase) and proven subgraphs compact to certificates plus a PV witness line. Well-evidenced evicted nodes route their lesson (settled minus raw) through palimpsest.observe on the way out â€” eviction as lossy compression into the context posterior, not amnesia. An explicit link-integrity protocol nulls parent child_keys slots (so FPU correctly treats the move as unexpanded), prunes children's parent sets, and dirty-marks parents. Retention fields (epoch stamp, root-distance color) must be in the node schema now.
clusters.rationale: The current clear-all detonates in exactly the games that matter: long grinds where 2.5M nodes is reached as the endgame begins â€” the engine's measured weakest phase â€” and today it can wipe a proven mate mid-conversion while keeping only the gossip (the palimpsest survives, the theorems do not). Perpetual settling and the compiled core multiply fill rates 10-100x, turning eviction from rare event to per-move routine. The paradigm dictates the design: if a guess, a lesson, and a proof are one object at three precisions, forgetting is DEMOTION across precisions, not deletion. Age/LRU is wrong in a transposition-merged graph because old nodes are revisited constantly; decision-relevance is the paradigm-native criterion. And under partial eviction, dangling parent back-pointers silently sever the settling engine's only propagation channel â€” link integrity is a correctness invariant of the dirty-queue contraction, not bookkeeping, and must be co-designed with proof revocation before the compiled core freezes the node layout.

clusters.title: The Aquifer: persistent cross-game lattice with variance reheating and game-end outcome fusion
clusters.summary: Stop clearing the lattice at new_game: serialize between games and rehydrate with 'reheated' beliefs â€” variance inflated as a function of evidence provenance and staleness, because a settled value was conditioned on a frontier that no longer exists and must re-enter as a strong prior, not as truth â€” while proof nodes persist verbatim because they are theorems (position-intrinsic given the existing key salting), so the engine organically accumulates a tablebase of endgames it has actually proven. At game end, fuse the actual result as one noisy variance-bearing observation along the played path before persisting, grounding settled beliefs in reality rather than only in search artifacts.
clusters.rationale: This is the affordance no tree engine has: nodes are position-keyed Bayesian beliefs, so transfer across games is literally the same no-op that re-rooting within a game already is â€” the identity claim 'the lattice IS the transposition table, the learner, and the proof store' is only fully true if the store outlives the game. An opening book partially falls out for free: early positions recur, accumulate evidence, and the broker's variance bonus automatically spends less there and more on novelty. The organically grown proof store attacks two stated weaknesses (no tablebases, weak endgame conversion) and gives proof-producing modules a place to write their outputs. Without it, the cross-game learning story reduces to retraining the oracle.

clusters.title: The Distillery: in-play harvest of settled beliefs as self-distillation and trajectory-head training data
clusters.summary: A harvest hook inside Engine._integrate and _create_node â€” the only places a chess.Board exists, since Zobrist keys are not invertible, which is why the schema must be designed now â€” logs per well-evidenced node: packed position, raw oracle WDL/mlh, settled WDL/value/variance, evidence mass, proof flag, and value snapshots at increasing eval counts. This corpus feeds (a) fine-tuning the oracle on settled values via precision-weighted regression using the native variances (proof nodes are exact zero-variance labels), (b) improved policy targets from settled child values, and (c) the deferred trajectory head, whose required supervision â€” 'what will further search conclude at effort k' â€” is exactly the value-at-eval-count trajectory settling produces as a byproduct.
clusters.rationale: AlphaZero-style pipelines must generate whole self-play games to get one noisy outcome label per game; here every think already manufactures thousands of labeled positions, because each node stores BOTH the oracle's prior and a strictly-improved posterior with calibrated uncertainty attached â€” the lattice IS the dataset and it is currently thrown away every game. No other component can raise the ceiling of a frozen BT4; everything else in the engine is decoration on the oracle's residual errors. One harvest schema serves distillation and the trajectory head simultaneously and must exist before either; this is the only proposal that compounds without bound.

clusters.title: Two-tier oracle economy: scout net + BT4 fused as precision-weighted measurements with cost-aware routing
clusters.summary: Add a second, much smaller Lc0 net (10-20x BT4's throughput) and turn node birth into a Bayesian measurement update over a per-node evidence ledger of (source id, wdl, mlh, precision) entries, with per-source observation noise calibrated online from each source's settled-vs-raw residual variance (the statistic the palimpsest machinery already computes). The broker emits typed eval requests â€” scout tier for breadth, verify tier (BT4) for depth â€” chosen per frontier leaf by expected value-of-information per second; previously scouted nodes can be UPGRADED by a BT4 measurement (a re-evaluation path that does not exist today: every node currently gets exactly one oracle call ever); escalation triggers include court-identified decision relevance and scout-vs-settled disagreement beyond variance. The fused prior must feed all three load-bearing raw_* consumers (FPU, backup's unexpanded fallback, node birth).
clusters.rationale: Evidence mass is the binding constraint â€” 450-1665 evals/s of single-fidelity evidence versus Stockfish's millions â€” and this paradigm is uniquely positioned to mix evidence qualities: in visit-count MCTS, mixing nets of different strengths corrupts the visit statistics that ARE the value estimate, whereas here beliefs carry explicit variance, so heteroscedastic sources fuse by the algebra the README already promises, and the court's joint posterior supplies a principled escalation trigger tree engines lack. It must be designed now because it changes the Node schema (multi-measurement posteriors, source tags), the broker's scoring objective, and forces deliberation budgets off uniform eval counts before the compiled core freezes the layout. The largest near-term strength delta available at design level.

clusters.title: Validity-domain beliefs with occurrence-aware keys: read-time graph-history soundness
clusters.summary: Replace write-time aliasing (16-ply rule50 buckets, binary rep salt applied only at terminal creation) with read-time domain checking: every belief carries the validity domain it was derived under â€” rule50 headroom at derivation and game-occurrence count (0/1/2+, known exactly from the true path via board.is_repetition(2) at node creation, also folded into the key) â€” and a lookup whose path falls outside the domain treats the stored belief as a prior to refine, not a truth to inherit. The write side must also be made coherent: oracle inputs are explicitly path-conditioned (rule50 plane 109, 8-ply history repetition flags) but cached first-writer-wins under a path-coarse key â€” either canonicalize inputs to the key's equivalence class or record the conditioning in the domain.
clusters.rationale: The lattice's founding bet is that position-keyed beliefs transpose for free, but chess values are path functions (rule50, repetition), so a single global store necessarily caches path-dependent numbers under path-coarse keys â€” a tree engine gets path correctness for free and never faces this; the belief lattice must solve it explicitly or it is formally unsound, not just inaccurate. Salting tries to solve it at write time and provably cannot (finite buckets, terminal-only rep salt); domains solve it at read time while preserving the transposition sharing that justifies the whole design. Verified triggers: bucket-boundary trust in fortress grinds and 50-move races, and second-occurrence reuse where accumulated evidence mass makes the court snap confidently on exactly the stalest values (consistent with the observed flat-eval draw streaks vs equals). Zobrist collisions were examined and dismissed (~2e-7 per full table) â€” the deliberate aliasing is the binding soundness risk. A precision claim without a statement of where it holds is not a claim.

clusters.title: Proof certificates with validity envelopes, budget arithmetic, and a revocation flow
clusters.summary: proof stops being a boolean and becomes a certificate: certifying child edge, exact ply-to-result bound (propagated as child bound + 1 through backup, reversible-ply budget reset at captures/pawn moves), a rule50-headroom condition (a win proof is valid for a consumer iff 100 âˆ’ halfmove_clock >= proof distance), and a repetition-context flag. Every proof consumer â€” broker skip, court instant-stop, _best_move's proven-win override, proof propagation, GC pinning â€” checks its actual clock context against the envelope. Add the inverse information flow, anti-proof propagation: when an envelope is violated or the certifying child is revised or evicted, the proof un-pins and the existing dirty queue carries the retraction rootward.
clusters.rationale: Proofs are the one belief the engine never re-examines (broker prices them at zero, backup short-circuits, proven-losing children promote parents irreversibly) AND the thing GC will pin forever â€” so a single false proof created through rule50-aliased keys (a KQ-vs-KR 'mate in 14' proven at halfmove_clock 96 with 6 plies of actual headroom) is permanent poison that propagates upward and instantly ends court deliberation. This is the classic graph-history-interaction problem, and the architecture's most distinctive claim â€” proofs are just variance-zero beliefs in the same propagation â€” is only sound if pins can never be wrong; a belief system that can pin but never retract is formally unsound the moment one pin is false. The dirty queue is already the perfect retraction channel, so revocation is a new flow through existing machinery. Prerequisite for every proof producer (Syzygy, PNS, Bedrock); it must live in the certificate schema before the compiled core bakes a boolean flag into the node layout.

clusters.title: Certainty-stratified ordering: divorce gamma-contraction from preference semantics
clusters.summary: Stop using gamma=0.997 simultaneously as the convergence contraction and as the preference order: store undiscounted beliefs plus an explicit distance-to-resolution field, and compare lexicographically by certainty class (proven > heuristic), then value, then distance, at every comparison site (backup argmax, broker scoring, _best_move, court root_stats). Gamma survives only as the cycle-damping device inside the settle step; this retires the 12% eff_value mlh nudge and the stale raw_mlh (frozen at creation, never re-queried) as comparison inputs.
clusters.rationale: As implemented, a certain win n plies out is worth 0.997^n, so any forced win beyond ~35 plies loses the interior backup argmax to an unproven 0.9 hunch (the proven-win override exists only in _best_move, not in backup), and deep all-proven values can even fall below the >0.5 proof-recognition threshold. In a tree, gamma-discounting is a tolerable depth-preference proxy because every node has one depth; the belief lattice is precisely the structure in which a node has NO unique depth â€” through transpositions the carried discount reflects settle-topology distance rather than game distance, so the same number means different things to parents at different depths: incoherent in a shared graph. The paradigm already owns the right objects (mlh is first-class, proofs are a first-class precision tier), and certainty should never be exchangeable for heuristic optimism at a fixed 0.3%-per-ply rate. Trigger is the measured weakness: KBN# and long conversions live exactly in the 40-80-ply regime where the discount prefers the wrong move.

clusters.title: Single-writer sharded settling with a packed atomic belief word
clusters.summary: Partition the lattice by key bits into shards, each owned by exactly one settler actor that is the sole writer of belief state; cross-shard dirty notifications travel over MPSC queues, replacing the global heapq. The Node schema is formally split into three sections decided now: immutable-at-birth (key, moves, priors), a single atomically-swappable packed belief word (value, variance, mlh, proof/terminal flags in one 128-bit CAS), and append-only concurrent structures (parents list; child_keys slots claimed by CAS). Brokers become pure readers plus edge-claimers; many broker threads feed one GPU request queue.
clusters.rationale: Settling is value iteration over a shared DAG, and backups commute and are idempotent under the gamma contraction, so backup ORDER is free â€” single-writer-per-shard plus message-passing preserves the convergence theorem with no locks on the hot path. Virtual loss only diversifies selection; it does not protect reads: a broker reading a torn (value, mlh, variance) triple corrupts every comparison, which is why the belief must be one atomic word rather than three fields. The races are already visible in the Python (_integrate writes parent.child_keys and node.parents while select reads them as plain dict/set/list mutations). This is the part of the compiled core that is design, not porting â€” the concurrency schema dictates the frozen node layout that nearly every other proposal writes into.

clusters.title: One cost currency: normalized eval units across court, broker, and oracle router
clusters.summary: All deliberation accounting moves from seconds to normalized oracle-cost units (1 unit = one scout eval; a BT4 eval costs its measured ratio, e.g. ~8 units). RootCourt.budgets emits soft/hard limits in units; an online exchange-rate estimator (the existing batch_ema generalized into a first-class component) converts clock to units only at the boundary; the broker's leaf-pricing function and the fidelity router draw their cost denominators from the same currency.
clusters.rationale: Stopping-as-inference is the stated design, but the posterior responds to information bought, not seconds spent â€” and the moment two oracle tiers with ~10x cost difference exist, wall-clock budgets cannot govern the router at all. This judges the deferred 'eval-denominated court budgets' item insufficient as scoped: it is not just the court â€” broker pricing, fidelity escalation, and ponder governance (where elapsed time is meaningless) must share the denominator or cannot be governed by one policy. The currency definition is the interface between court, broker, and router and must precede the compiled core.

clusters.title: Palimpsest as a per-source Bayesian linear calibration head over oracle trunk embeddings
clusters.summary: Generalize the palimpsest from a context-keyed scalar table to a Bayesian linear head over a compact oracle trunk embedding, learned per evidence source: each lesson (settled value minus that source's raw value) updates a per-source posterior, so e.g. the scout net is continuously recalibrated toward BT4-verified settles in-game. Architectural commitments needed now: the ONNX export must expose a trunk-embedding output, the node schema reserves a quantized/projected embedding handle (raw 512-d fp16 at 2.5M nodes is 2.5 GB, so projection/quantization is a schema decision), and lessons carry source ids.
clusters.rationale: The palimpsest is the 'lesson' rung of the guess/lesson/proof ladder, and palimpsest.py's own docstring already declares the 512-d seam the thing v0 must get right â€” this defines that seam concretely. With a two-tier oracle it becomes the paradigm-native cross-calibration mechanism: per-source bias correction is exactly what lets a cheap scout net borrow BT4's calibration mid-game, for THIS opponent and THIS game's structures, which no offline training run can do. Retrofitting fails twice over: the node layout is frozen by the concurrent schema, and an ONNX graph without the trunk output cannot be amended without re-export and re-validation of the whole oracle path.

clusters.title: The Mirror: a second settled field per node â€” opponent-conditional value via expectation backup
clusters.summary: Add one parallel scalar field v~ ('value under their likely play') to Node, settled by the same dirty queue with a turn-dependent operator: at engine-to-move nodes v~ = max_i(-gamma * v~_child) as now; at opponent-to-move nodes v~ = sum_i p~_i * (-gamma * v~_child), where p~ is the opponent model's move distribution (stored policy priors temperature-sharpened by the opponent model, unexpanded children priced at raw_value as the frontier already is). The expectation operator with gamma is still a contraction, so existing settling theory and SETTLE_EPS propagation hold; one dirty-queue pass settles both fields. The per-node gap g = v* âˆ’ v~ is expected opponent regret â€” a derived, searchable measure of trappiness â€” and decisions blend v* and v~ through the utility layer with a weight set by estimated opponent strength.
clusters.rationale: The belief lattice represents opponent-conditional values more cleanly than any tree engine could: the lattice already stores everything the expectation backup needs at every node, side-to-move is baked into the position key so each node has a fixed operator for the whole game, transpositions merge both fields for free, and parent back-pointers carry a revised frontier v~ to the root in the same prioritized pass as v*. It directly attacks the measured failure mode: vs equal opposition every line has v* â‰ˆ 0 and the engine has literally no signal to prefer one flat move over another, so it shuffles into draws â€” v~ breaks the tie by revealing which 0.00 positions bleed value under fallible play. It also generalizes tension-preservation without hand-coding it: premature simplification is precisely a move that collapses g to zero. 'Value under best play' and 'value under their play' are the same belief object under two settling operators â€” a natural extension of the unifying idea.

clusters.title: The Effigy: an in-game Bayesian opponent model, palimpsest-shaped
clusters.summary: A second in-game learner alongside the Palimpsest: a low-dimensional posterior over opponent parameters â€” softmax temperature tau over move utilities plus a blunder-mixture weight eps (optionally phase-split) â€” updated in closed-ish form after every observed opponent move. The likelihood of their actual move under (tau, eps) is computable from the lattice itself, because the position they just moved from is still resident with full priors and settled child values: one lookup, no extra GPU work. The posterior mean drives the Mirror's p~ and the utility layer's parameters (u_D, the v*/v~ blend, the drift-horizon term); like the Palimpsest it is learned mid-game and discarded at game end.
clusters.rationale: Only this architecture gets the likelihood for free: because the lattice persists across moves within a game, the opponent's decision node is already settled when their reply arrives â€” a tree engine re-rooting from scratch would have to reconstruct it. The Palimpsest has already proven the pattern (conjugate in-game posterior, evidence gating, ablation flag, cleared at game end); the Effigy is the same seam pointed at the opponent instead of the oracle. It makes the standing 'no static contempt' decision coherent rather than merely cautious: contempt becomes an inferred quantity with error bars instead of a UCI knob â€” against full Stockfish it concludes near-perfection within ~10 moves and switches utility to P(not-loss) (losses toward draws); against SF-3000-class play it licenses regret-seeking (draws toward wins). The same machinery that wins more vs weaker opponents automatically turns itself off where wrongly-applied contempt would convert draws into losses.

clusters.title: Bounded beliefs: proven floors and ceilings as the missing intermediate precision
clusters.summary: Widen the belief datatype from (value, variance, proof: bool) to carry proven bounds [lo, hi]: lo = a value the side to move can force, hi = the best it could possibly achieve. Backup propagates floors cheaply and asymmetrically â€” any single bounded child gives the parent a floor (lo_parent = max over evaluated children of -hi_child), no full expansion needed â€” while ceilings require all children bounded, which is exactly the current all-proven condition, so today's proof propagation becomes the lo=hi special case. Repetition and stalemate terminals (which the broker already creates as exact nodes) become floor generators: 'I can always bail to this perpetual' propagates rootward as a proven draw floor through the same dirty queue. The court gains a resting condition (chosen move's floor >= draw while behind => snap and bank time), and defensive play anchors on floors rather than noisy net evals.
clusters.rationale: The founding sentence â€” guess, lesson, and proof are one object at three precisions â€” is currently realized only for exact values; bounds are the missing intermediate precision and slot into existing machinery with zero new infrastructure (same nodes, same dirty queue, same contraction since bounds are monotone under max-backup, same court). It is the direct architectural mechanism for losses-into-draws against stronger opposition, which neither the utility layer nor the opponent model addresses: at 450 evals/s STILLWATER will keep losing tactical arguments to Stockfish's millions of nps, but a secured repetition floor is a theorem Stockfish's speed cannot take away â€” and the engine currently throws that information away the moment a non-draw sibling scores 0.02 higher. Lc0-family nets are notoriously blind to fortresses; a floor is immune to that blindness. Sharpens the vague 'Bedrock' deferral into a datatype change that must precede the compiled core's frozen node layout.
